description: Main window: API calls to the user's own server through beacon_fetch only (Rust HTTP client with TLS public-key pinning for the official Beacon host, docs/PINNING.md; HTTPS, or loopback for development; no HTTP plugin), and the app's own commands (keychain: whether a session token is stored, starting a sign-in and sign-out only, never the token itself, which Rust keeps with its origin and adds to requests to that origin only; the chat token (BD-2) likewise: its status, "Connect chat" and "Disconnect chat" only, attached by Rust to chat routes only; the tasks token (BD-3b) likewise: its status, "Connect tasks" and "Disconnect tasks" only, attached by Rust to task-board routes only, plus parking it for a server logout retry that Rust sends at the next start, and deleting what is parked at Clear local data (tasks_revoke_park / tasks_revoke_retry / tasks_revoke_clear, 0.14.1); the chat realtime stream runs in Rust and sends ids-only hints; the unread badge; the count of chat messages waiting to send (only the count) and quitting after the person confirmed discarding them (BDA14-L3); tray, updater, heartbeat, notifications, the prompt window, links through open_external in the browser chosen with set_browser / pick_browser (the custom-browser file dialog is opened from Rust, so the webview has no dialog permission), writing copied links to the clipboard); the main window may resize and move itself ("Compact view" / "Full view") and bring itself forward (show, unminimize, focus: a required-fields dialog to answer, BD-3a); its own title bar on Windows and Linux, where the window has no system frame (UX batch 7, UXA-45): start-dragging (the drag region), minimize, toggle-maximize and close (close only hides it to the tray, Rust prevents the close); the mini timer window (open, update, close; its buttons come back as events). Each app command is declared in build.rs and granted here per window.
